page.layout: One column of running text in the centre. One marginal note on the left, beside the paragraph at "Pighius". Show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page on the right are not transcribed.

l.i: DEUM NOBIS DEBITOREM ESSE: quia posterior
meriti sine gratia, vel certè sine gratuita retri-butione; quod

main_text.l: prior sensus non facit. Sic ille. Quâ
Meriti de condigno nihil esse potest repu-

rationem consequi ex dignitate operum, in
qua formalis ratio meriti de condigno omni-no

l.i: ullum nobis à Deo esse debitum, qui
servi inutiles sumus, faciendo quod debuimus:
imò supra quàm inutiles, non faciendo etiam quod

main_text.l: hîc interponat judicium? Hoc meriti genus, inquit,

l.i: locum non habet inter Deum & homines,
cùm illum nobis debitorem nullâ ratione possimus
quod sumus, & quod facimus, & quod possumus.

main_text.l: Sic ille. Objectionem hanc olim Schola
urgebat, viz. Debitum esse ut merces rependa-tur.

page.notes: The mark before "Pighius" is a superscript letter (read as m) and the marginal note carries the same mark. "Absit" has a decorated initial A that is hard to read; read as Absit. Right edge of the scan shows part of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse side is present throughout.
